registerInterpretation.finding: The D-trumpet standard is a major second above written pitch. Given the source’s written C5/C4 and old MIDI D4/D3, the specific +12 correction restores D5/D4. This is not a blanket octave rule for all historical brass. F-basset-horn and choral registers remain as encoded.

The single original organ/orchestral-bass staff remains one source line; no inferred cello, double-bass, trombone doubling or realised continuo is invented. No gross arrangement mismatch identified.
